doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Goodbye and copy of the interview
summary: Rowe thanks Gibbs, who asks for a copy of the recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Good one. All right. Well listen, I hope you have a safe trip home. Best of luck with your upcoming things, and I really appreciate your time.
Is there any way I’m getting a copy of this?
You have my address at home I take it?
I do. I will send you a copy.
I’d like to hear some of these stupid things that I say on these interviews.
